title: Zero-product problem for Toeplitz operators on the Fock space
summary: We answer Bauer and Le's question on zero products of Toeplitz operators on the Fock space $F^2(\mathbb C^n)$[JFA, 261 (2011), 9, 2617--2640]. For $n\ge2$, we construct two bounded nonradial Schwartz symbols on $\mathbb C^n$ whose Toeplitz operators are nonzero and have zero product on $F^2(\mathbb C^n)$. For $n=1$ and each $c\in(1/2,1)$, we construct two smooth nonradial symbols of growth at most $Ce^{c|z|^2}$ for some constant $C>0$.
